criteria.description: Use the exact manifest-only SP1-prover LRU correction with full archive/license provenance, meaningful host/cache/service tests and five unsuppressed application lock audits denying unsound advisories.

Pin unmodified real SP1 verifier/gateway source and the reviewed Arcora ELF/vkey; compile the real target and pass malformed-proof guards, substituted-artifact rejection and existing contract regressions without claiming an application proof.

Generate a genuine ordinary local CPU Groth16 proof from the exact synthetic witness; verify native/public equality and local SDK acceptance, preserve hash-bound artifacts and unchanged relevant source identity. A resource stop or infrastructure failure cannot pass.

The produced Arcora proof must pass the actual pinned verifier, official gateway and adapter in local EVM, while wrong key/input/proof/selector/truncation and unavailable routes fail; all 18 integration tests must execute successfully.

Independently review changed code, reconcile current source/evidence identity and original unchanged task criteria/dependencies, preserve Desktop work, and update the reviewable existing PR without merging or claiming production readiness.
